findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess usage in dateutil
 * @description Find any subprocess calls that might be vulnerable to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-usage-dateutil
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall()
select call, "Subprocess call found, could be vulnerable to command injection if untrusted input is used"
findings.hypothesis: Subprocess calls in dateutil could be vulnerable to command injection if user input flows to them
